name: Ironashi
source:
New member of [url=https://jinki.fandom.com/wiki/Kyomu]Kyomu[/url]'s Hachishoujin (8 General). He piloted Dark Schneiger (ダークシュナイガ).

[spoiler]He is the embodiment of Kyomu's Leader, [url=https://jinki.fandom.com/wiki/Kokusho]Kokushou [/url](黒将)'s black wave (黒い波動), whose death in a war against Canaima branch of Ángel in Venezuela years ago. It is the result of [url=/c131878]Shiva[/url] and the Hachishoujin trying to resurrect their leader. But the resurrection isn't completed yet, so he still doesn't have Kokushou's memories.

Kokushou's real identity is Hino Hakuya (日野 白矢), [url=/c88148]Aoba[/url]'s father.[/spoiler]
